Hero Ice Wizard, release 2026-09-05 (Season 87). Ability Frosty Fella, 2 elixir, single use: triggers on the next slowing hit and spawns a Snowman 1 tile behind the target (works on towers). Snowman: 266 HP at level 11 draining over a 7s lifetime, spawn damage 89 in a 2.5 tile radius (38 to crown towers), freezes everything inside that radius for as long as it lives (duration 7.0 is the cap), self-destructs 2s after all frozen targets die.
